description: The systematic study of the structure and behavior of the physical and natural world through observation, experiment, and mathematical reasoning.

subdomains.name: Physics
subdomains.description: Studies matter, energy, motion, and force, from subatomic particles to the cosmos; core branches include mechanics, thermodynamics, electromagnetism, and quantum theory.

subdomains.name: Chemistry
subdomains.description: Examines the composition, structure, properties, and reactions of substances; spans organic, inorganic, physical, and analytical chemistry.

subdomains.name: Biology
subdomains.description: The study of living organisms, covering genetics, cell biology, evolution, ecology, physiology, and molecular biology.

subdomains.name: Mathematics
subdomains.description: The abstract science of number, quantity, structure, and space, underpinning algebra, geometry, calculus, statistics, and logic.

subdomains.name: Astronomy
subdomains.description: Studies celestial objects, space, and the physical universe, including stars, planets, galaxies, and cosmology.

subdomains.name: Earth Science
subdomains.description: Covers geology, meteorology, oceanography, and the physical processes shaping the planet.

subdomains.name: Environmental Science
subdomains.description: An interdisciplinary study of ecosystems, pollution, conservation, and the interaction between humans and the natural world.

subdomains.name: Space Science
subdomains.description: Focuses on space exploration, astrophysics, planetary science, and spacecraft/satellite technology.
